translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Wuoda, chik iti malongʼo ne riekona,
mondo iwinj maber puonj mago mopondo,
eka isik kingʼeyo pogo tiend weche
kendo dhogi norit rieko.
Nimar dho jachode wacho weche mamit ka mor kich,
kendo wuoyone yom maloyo moo;
to gikone okech ka kedhno
kendo obith ka ligangla ma dhoge ariyo.
Tiendene ochomo kar tho,
to ondamo mage ochiko bur tir.
Ok opar ngangʼ yor ngima; yorene ogondore,
to ok ongʼeyo kamano.
Omiyo koro un yawuota, winjauru,
kik uwe gima awachonu.
Bed mabor gi dhako ma kamano,
kendo kik idhi machiegni gi dhoode,
nono to jomoko nono ema inimi tekreni maber moloyo
kendo higni magi norum e lwet joma ger,
nono to jomoko nono, ema nocham mwanduni
kendo tichni matek nokony od ngʼat moro nono.
To e giko mar ngimani inichur achura,
ka ringri gi dendi chamore rumo.
To iniwachi niya, “Mano kaka nasin gi puonj mar rieko!
Mano kaka chunya nokwedo siem mane omiya kuom gik mane atimo ma ok nikare!
Ne ok anyal winjo kendo timo weche jopuonjna,
kata chiko ita ni jopuonjna.
Asechopo e giko mar kethruok marach
e dier chokruok mangima.”
Modh pi moa e dapigi iwuon,
pi mamol moa e sokoni iwuon.
Bende ber mondo soknigi omol ka oo oko e yore mag dala,
kata aoregi mag pi e kuonde chokruok manie dier dala?
Ne ni gibedo magi iwuon
kendo kik iriwgi gi joma galagala.
Sokoni mondo ogwedhi,
kendo ibed mamor gi chiegi mane ikendo ka in wuowi.
Ojaber ka mwanda, kendo olongʼo ka nyakech,
thundene mad romi kinde duto, mad herane omaki moloyo.
Wuoda, ere gima omiyo jachode dikaw paroni?
Ere gima omiyo chie ngʼato nono dilombi?
Yore mag dhano nenore ratiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo onono kamoro amora ma odhiyoe.
Timbe mamono mag ngʼama jaricho obedone obadho mamake,
tonde mag richone tweye matek.
Obiro tho nikech ok oyie mondo orieye,
obayo yo nikech fupe maduongʼ.
